Change c0467. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): For they had called me mad; and during many months, as I understood, a solitary cell had been my habitation.

1818 text: But liberty had been a useless gift to me had I not, as I awakened to reason, at the same time awakened to revenge.

1831 text: Liberty, however, had been an useless gift to me, had I not, as I awakened to reason, at the same time awakened to revenge.

Diff: [-But liberty-] {+Liberty, however,+} had been [-a-] {+an+} useless gift to me {+,+} had I not, as I awakened to reason, at the same time awakened to revenge.

Context after (unchanged): As the memory of past misfortunes pressed upon me, I began to reflect on their cause—the monster whom I had created, the miserable dæmon whom I had sent abroad into the world for my destruction.

result.rationale: Replaces 'But' with 'Liberty, however,' and 'a' with 'an', plus a comma; rephrases the sentence's connective and adds a grammatical article fix, keeping the sense of revenge following liberty unchanged.
